title: SPARQL-Planned Single-Hop Traversal over a Live Knowledge Graph for Multi-Hop Question Answering
abstract: arXiv:2611.31771v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Semantic retrieval struggles with multi-hop question answering on both recall and precision: gold passages are buried among distractors that degrade the reader's answer, and retrieving them requires reasoning over the query rather than matching it. GraphRAG techniques expand semantic retrieval by connecting passages to graph nodes and performing one or more hops of expansion after initial retrieval. This improves recall, but multi-hop expansion becomes expensive and brings additional noise into the retrieved set. We break this tradeoff by \emph{interleaving} dense retrieval with knowledge-graph traversal for complex multi-hop questions. Dense retrieval locates the first relevant regions of the search space at good recall, while traversal of a pre-existing external KG (Wikidata) restores precision and improves recall by confirming retrieved passages against a reasoning path through the KG. translated_title: 面向多跳问答的基于SPARQL规划的在线知识图谱单跳遍历
translated_abstract: 语义检索在多跳问答的召回率和精确率两方面都陷入困境：黄金（正确）段落被淹没在干扰项之中，从而降低阅读器生成答案的质量，而检索这些段落需要对查询进行推理，而非简单匹配。GraphRAG技术通过将段落连接到图节点并在初始检索后执行一跳或多跳扩展来增强语义检索，这提升了召回率，但多跳扩展代价高昂，并且会给检索结果引入额外噪声。我们通过将稠密检索与知识图谱遍历交替执行来打破这种权衡，以应对复杂的多跳问题。稠密检索以较高的召回率定位搜索空间中最初相关的区域，而对预先存在的外部知识图谱（Wikidata）的遍历则通过依据知识图谱中的推理路径对检索到的段落进行验证，从而恢复精确率并提升召回率。为使遍历既具问题自适应性又……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出将稠密检索与基于SPARQL规划的在线知识图谱（Wikidata）单跳遍历交替进行，通过推理路径验证检索段落，在避免多跳扩展开销与噪声的同时兼顾召回率与精确率，从而提升多跳问答性能。
en_tdlr: This paper interleaves dense retrieval with SPARQL-planned single-hop traversal over a live knowledge graph (Wikidata), validating retrieved passages against reasoning paths to balance recall and precision without the cost and noise of multi-hop expansion for multi-hop question answering.
